title: D2 advisory locks spec
description: Schema for contracts/advisory-locks/advisory-locks.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog of PostgreSQL session advisory lock keys. Each entry declares a named lock with an explicit bigint key and the database it belongs to. A Roslyn source generator emits AdvisoryLocks into D2.Shared.EntityFrameworkCore.Postgres and enforces per-database key uniqueness at build time.

constName.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE C# constant identifier, unique within its database.

database.description: The owning database (lowercase snake_case, e.g. keycustodian_db). The same key value is legal in two different databases — lock keyspaces are per-database.

key.description: Explicit signed 64-bit integer passed to pg_advisory_lock / pg_try_advisory_lock. Caller-chosen — stable, well-separated values reduce collision risk. Must be unique within its database.

doc.description: XML summary text rendered on the emitted constant.
